# Bun: lineCoverage

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To enable line coverage in Bun, configure the RunOptions object with the lineCoverage flag. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact property name for the lineCoverage flag. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: expected data type for the lineCoverage flag. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: default value if the lineCoverage flag is not set.

Search intents:
- Bun lineCoverage
- Bun test coverage

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-linecoverage --json
